claims: Maintain continuous pulse oximetry and cardiac monitoring with alarms for SpO2 <92% and heart rate outside 50-130 bpm.
Continue noninvasive ventilation (NIV-ST) with current settings and monitor for worsening respiratory status or need for escalation.
Obtain arterial blood gas to reassess hypercapnia and oxygenation given pCO2 51 mm Hg and A-a gradient 586 mm Hg.
Assess and manage severe pain (reported 8-10/10) with the ordered IV opioid (morphine) as needed, monitoring respiratory status.
Continue scheduled IV antibiotics (vancomycin, levofloxacin, metronidazole) as ordered for presumed infection.
Check serum potassium and magnesium levels and replace electrolytes as indicated, given recent oral potassium and IV magnesium orders.
Perform daily assessment of sedation and delirium using Richmond-RAS and CAM-ICU, targeting RASS 0.
Implement fall precautions and assist with mobility given bed rest and weakness, while encouraging progressive mobilization as tolerated.
Monitor temperature and obtain cultures if new fever develops, continuing current antimicrobial coverage.
Continue maintenance IV fluids (NaCl 0.9% at 5 mL/hour) and monitor intake/output and electrolytes.
